about: Made by tools/art-import/import_art.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

grass.note: grass ground tile, exactly 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left corner of the cell. Tiles seamlessly

grass-flowers.note: grass-flowers ground tile, exactly 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left corner of the cell. Tiles seamlessly

path.note: path: flagstone path tile, 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left of the cell

path-edge-w.note: path-edge-w: flagstone path tile, 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left of the cell; grass verge on the w side

path-edge-e.note: path-edge-e: flagstone path tile, 80 x 80 px; anchorPx = top-left of the cell; grass verge on the e side

hedge-face.note: low hedge on a stone kerb for the room's top edge, one tile wide; repeat along the top row; anchorPx = bottom-left of its cell; blocks the cell

hedge-block.note: the same hedge seen from above, for the side and bottom edges; anchorPx = bottom-left of its cell; blocks the cell

tower-foot.note: the foot of the stone Tower with its big arched door; the tower rises off the top of the screen. 5 tiles wide; footprint rows -2.4..2 (the steps are the bottom row); place across the top of the Tower Path room so the path ends at the steps. anchorPx = bottom-centre of the 5x2 footprint. The door is the 'D' spot; the bow happens on the steps

decor-rocks.note: a few small path-side rocks (blocks 1 cell)

decor-tree.note: a round blossom tree for the path's sides (blocks 1 cell)

stone.note: the falling stone (1 frame). The game drops it from above onto the red circle's centre (anchorPx = its resting ground point), then swaps to stone-land on the landing tick. Its shadow is the red circle itself

stone-land.note: 12 frames at 12 fps (1 s), plays once on the landing tick: impact squash (0), bounce (1-2), sits (3-7), shrinks away (8-11). The stone-dust layer is the cartoon puff ring; draw it over the stone. Same anchor as 'stone'. Cue a soft thud on frame 0

dummy-small-idle.note: dummy-small: still idle (it never moves or attacks). anchorPx = its foot point on the ground

dummy-small-hit.note: dummy-small: hit wobble, 8 frames at 16 fps (0.5 s), once per hit; restart on each new hit. Ends on the idle pose

dummy-small-defeat.note: dummy-small: beaten, 12 frames at 12 fps (1 s), once: wobbles, puffs up, then pops into straw bits and little stars (no breaking or tearing). Layers: dummy-small then dummy-small-puff on top. Cue a soft 'poof' on frame 7

dummy-big-idle.note: dummy-big: still idle (it never moves or attacks). anchorPx = its foot point on the ground

dummy-big-hit.note: dummy-big: hit wobble, 8 frames at 16 fps (0.5 s), once per hit; restart on each new hit. Ends on the idle pose

dummy-big-defeat.note: dummy-big: beaten, 12 frames at 12 fps (1 s), once: wobbles, puffs up, then pops into straw bits and little stars (no breaking or tearing). Layers: dummy-big then dummy-big-puff on top. Cue a soft 'poof' on frame 7

stumble-stars.note: 3 little stars circling (12-frame loop at 12 fps = 1 s) for the stumble. anchorPx = the ring's centre: put it on the top of the hero's head. Plays only for the short stumble pause; gold and cream, never red
